title: Fine-Tuning Gemma 4 Edge Models for MATLAB Signal-Processing Code with SFT and QLoRA on a Laptop iGPU
abstract: arXiv:2611.23205v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small language models that run on a laptop are attractive for writing signal-processing code offline, but they make systematic errors on digital signal processing (DSP) conventions. We apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to the Gemma 4 edge models E2B and E4B with 66 checked examples covering 11 signal-processing MATLAB subtasks, using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and quantized LoRA (QLoRA) on the integrated GPU (iGPU) of a laptop, and deploy the 8-bit integer (int8) models with the adapters through OpenVINO. On held-out variants scored by deterministic checkers, the pass rate rises from 18/66 to 37/66 (LoRA) and 37/66 (QLoRA) for E2B and from 32/66 to 47/66 for E4B (QLoRA). Reading all 159 failing programs shows that the adapters remove most errors of convention, such as the sign of a lag, units and array shapes, but few errors in building signals and noise. Applied at run time, the adapter costs 17-19% of the generation speed.

translated_title: 在笔记本电脑集成GPU上使用SFT与QLoRA微调Gemma 4边缘模型以生成MATLAB信号处理代码
translated_abstract: 能在笔记本电脑上运行的小型语言模型对于离线编写信号处理代码很有吸引力，但它们在数字信号处理（DSP）惯例方面会犯系统性错误。我们使用66个经过检查的样例（涵盖11个信号处理MATLAB子任务）对Gemma 4边缘模型E2B和E4B进行监督微调（SFT），在笔记本电脑的集成GPU（iGPU）上采用低秩适应（LoRA）和量化低秩适应（QLoRA），并通过OpenVINO部署带有适配器的8位整数（int8）模型。在由确定性检查器评分的保留测试变体上，E2B的通过率从18/66提升至37/66（LoRA）和37/66（QLoRA），E4B的通过率从32/66提升至47/66（QLoRA）。通过阅读全部159个失败程序发现，适配器消除了大多数惯例性错误（如滞后的符号、单位和数组形状），但很少修复构建信号和噪声方面的错误。在运行时应用适配器会使生成速度降低17-19%。
tldr: 该论文在笔记本电脑集成GPU上用66个样例通过SFT结合LoRA/QLoRA微调Gemma 4边缘模型（E2B和E4B）用于MATLAB信号处理代码生成，使通过率显著提升（如E4B从32/66升至47/66），且发现微调主要修正DSP惯例错误而非信号构建错误，运行时代价仅为17-19%的生成速度损失。
